name: Yakyuuken de Pakopako Batsu Game ~Shinseki no Onna no Ko~
original_name: 野球拳でパコパコ罰ゲーム～親戚の女の子～

Your niece challenges you to a game of rock, paper, strippers!
But what happens if you lose? A sexy penalty game, of course!
